cat_camel.name: Cat-Camel
cat_camel.how: Gently move between rounded and arched spine positions.
cat_camel.avoid: Move slowly. This is not a deep stretch for the lower back.
cat_camel.query: cat camel exercise physical therapy demonstration

open_book.name: Open Book Thoracic Rotation
open_book.how: Lie on your side with knees stacked and rotate through the upper back.
open_book.avoid: Keep knees together. Do not force the low back to twist.
open_book.query: open book thoracic rotation exercise demonstration

9090.name: 90/90 Hip Rotations
9090.avoid: Use your hands for support. Do not rush or force range.

adductor.name: Adductor Rock-Back
adductor.how: From hands and knees, extend one leg to the side and rock hips back.
adductor.avoid: Keep spine neutral. Move from hips, not low back.

ankle_rock.name: Supported Ankle Rock / Knee-to-Wall
ankle_rock.how: Drive knee forward over toes while keeping heel down.
ankle_rock.avoid: Comfortable range only on repaired Achilles side.
ankle_rock.query: knee to wall ankle dorsiflexion exercise demonstration

wrist_cars.name: Wrist CARs
wrist_cars.how: Slowly draw controlled wrist circles while keeping forearm still.
wrist_cars.avoid: Use the largest pain-free circle you can control.
wrist_cars.query: wrist CARs controlled articular rotations demonstration

curl_up.name: Modified McGill Curl-Up
curl_up.how: One knee bent, one leg straight. Brace and slightly lift head/shoulders.
curl_up.avoid: Do not crunch repeatedly. Keep lumbar position stable.

bird_dog.name: Bird Dog
bird_dog.how: Extend opposite arm and leg while keeping torso still.
bird_dog.avoid: The goal is zero hip/lumbar movement.
bird_dog.query: bird dog exercise demonstration physical therapy

side_plank.name: Side Plank from Knees
side_plank.how: Elbow under shoulder. Lift hips until knees, hips, shoulders align.
side_plank.avoid: Do not rotate pelvis or shrug shoulder.
side_plank.query: modified side plank from knees demonstration

glute_bridge.name: Glute Bridge
glute_bridge.how: Brace, squeeze glutes, lift hips, stop before low back takes over.
glute_bridge.avoid: Avoid arching the lower back at the top.

short_foot.name: Short Foot
short_foot.how: Gently shorten the foot by lifting the arch without curling toes.

band_er.name: Band External Rotation
band_er.how: Elbow near side. Rotate forearm outward with light band resistance.
band_er.avoid: Do not rotate your torso or shrug.

face_pull.name: Seated Band Face Pull
face_pull.how: Pull band toward face while seated, elbows high but shoulders down.
face_pull.avoid: Keep ribs down and avoid leaning back.

wall_slide.name: Scapular Wall Slide
wall_slide.how: Slide arms up wall while keeping ribs controlled.
wall_slide.avoid: Do not arch low back to get arms higher.

wrist_prosup.name: Wrist Pronation/Supination
wrist_prosup.how: Support forearm and rotate palm up/down using a hammer or light DB.

tib_raise.name: Tibialis Raise
tib_raise.how: Heels down, lift toes/forefoot toward shins, lower slowly.
tib_raise.avoid: Do not rock your whole body.

balance.name: Supported Single-Leg Balance
balance.how: Stand near rack or wall and use fingertip support as needed.
balance.avoid: Alignment matters more than no-hand balance.
balance.query: supported single leg balance exercise demonstration

box_squat.name: Bodyweight Box Squat
box_squat.how: Sit to a box with controlled depth, stand smoothly.
box_squat.avoid: Tripod foot, brace, no lumbar collapse. Achilles controls depth.

hip_hinge.name: Dowel / Unloaded Hip Hinge
hip_hinge.how: Brace and push hips back while maintaining neutral trunk.
hip_hinge.avoid: Feel hamstrings/glutes. Do not round low back.

smith_bench_light.name: Very Light Smith Bench
smith_bench_light.how: Use light load to rehearse scapular control, neutral wrist, smooth press.
smith_bench_light.query: smith machine bench press technique demonstration

cable_row.name: Seated Cable Row
cable_row.how: Tall torso, brace, pull through elbows, controlled return.
cable_row.avoid: Do not lean or jerk the weight.

db_press.name: Seated Light Dumbbell Press
db_press.how: Press overhead while seated, ribs down and core braced.

smith_incline.name: Smith Incline Bench Press
smith_incline.how: Light, controlled incline press for upper chest.
smith_incline.avoid: Keep shoulder blades controlled and wrists neutral.
smith_incline.query: smith machine incline bench press demonstration

lat_pd.name: Lat Pulldown
lat_pd.how: Pull bar toward upper chest with controlled shoulder blade movement.

cable_curl.name: Cable Curl
cable_curl.how: Curl with elbows stable and controlled lowering.

rope_pd.name: Rope Pressdown
rope_pd.how: Press rope down while keeping elbows near sides.
rope_pd.avoid: Do not let shoulders roll forward.

belt_squat.name: Belt Squat
belt_squat.how: Light squat pattern with stable feet and trunk.
belt_squat.avoid: Do not chase depth. Keep heel planted.

smith_legpress.name: Smith Leg Press Attachment
smith_legpress.how: Controlled press with heel planted and even pressure through foot.
smith_legpress.avoid: Avoid bouncing or locking knees aggressively.
smith_legpress.query: smith machine leg press attachment demonstration

pullthrough.name: Cable Pull-Through
pullthrough.how: Hinge hips back, then drive hips forward with glutes.
pullthrough.avoid: This rebuilds hinge capacity before deadlifting.

hamcurl.name: Hamstring Curl
hamcurl.how: Curl heels toward glutes under control.

hip_abd.name: Cable Hip Abduction
hip_abd.how: Move leg out to side under control.

dead_bug.name: Dead Bug
dead_bug.how: Brace and move opposite arm/leg while low back stays controlled.

pallof.name: Pallof Press
pallof.how: Press cable/band forward while resisting rotation.
pallof.avoid: Keep ribs down and pelvis still.

seated_calf.name: Seated Bent-Knee Calf Raise
seated_calf.how: Load the soleus with knee bent; slow lowering.
seated_calf.avoid: Progress gradually and track next-morning response.
seated_calf.query: seated calf raise bent knee demonstration

dl_calf.name: Double-Leg Standing Calf Raise
dl_calf.how: Rise using both legs, pause, lower slowly.
dl_calf.avoid: No bouncing. Full controlled available range.
dl_calf.query: double leg standing calf raise demonstration

assisted_sl_calf.name: Assisted Single-Leg Calf Raise
assisted_sl_calf.how: Use hands to reduce load while practicing single-leg raise mechanics.
assisted_sl_calf.avoid: Quality and heel height matter more than reps.
assisted_sl_calf.query: assisted single leg calf raise demonstration

sl_ecc.name: Assisted Single-Leg Eccentric
sl_ecc.how: Rise with both legs, lower with repaired-side bias using support.
sl_ecc.avoid: Skip if control is poor or next-day stiffness increases.
sl_ecc.query: assisted single leg eccentric calf raise demonstration

inv_ev.name: Banded Inversion/Eversion
inv_ev.how: Move ankle inward and outward against light band resistance.
